title: Proper ordinary native module direct image preserves bounded constructibility
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l unequal to D.p, and a normalized realization Family F [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization]. For separated finite-type geometric spaces Z,T and a proper k-morphism p:Z→T, let O be any Operations for the realizations F.data Z.realization and F.data T.realization [def-sf-native-proper-coefficient-operations]. Then for every ordinary module derived object K satisfying boundedConstructible_Z(K), the object ContinuousRational.DirectImage.derivedPush(p,O.coefficient)(K) satisfies boundedConstructible_T. The coefficient map has O.functions precomposition normalization; neither an isomorphism a or b nor any adjunction-comparison equation is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15 (pp. 61-62), with the proper finiteness of Lemma 6.7.2: finite-field continuous realization and its actual ambient operations. Common-stage, tensor-normalized adjunction comparison is an agent-formulated consequence, not a verbatim statement of the proposition.; proper-adjunction proof Step 5 only.

proof.text: Give Z and T their Over instances from their structural maps; p.w supplies p.IsOver, and hp supplies properness, hence the separated finite-type hypotheses. Apply exists_coefficient_construction over the canonical universe lift of PadicAlgCl and then locally_finite_adic_compact_support_realization to Compactification.ofIsProper p.left. This gives native geometry G and the preservation field C.preserves for the compactification (identity,p). No extra Tor condition on the input is needed: this preservation field is stated on the native boundedAdicConstructible predicate.

The adjunct of O.coefficient and the adjunct of (G.pull p.left).hom have identical values: both are precomposition of locally finite functions by the same base-change projection. Extensionality on test objects, sections and points, followed by injectivity of the sheaf adjunction Hom equivalence, gives equality of these coefficient maps. Unfolding the two sectionwise pushforward definitions then gives equality of ContinuousRational.DirectImage.modulePush and proEtaleRingModuleDirectImage with G.pull.

Identity adic pullback is isomorphic to the identity functor. Uniqueness of left adjoints therefore identifies extension by zero along the identity with the identity. Apply mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryIdIso and whisker with the proper right-derived direct image: actual l (ofIsProper p) is isomorphic to native derived direct image. The canonical properTransport of G compares native derived direct image followed by sections with sections followed by the ringed derived direct image. Apply rightDerivedFunctorNatIso to the equality of sectionwise direct images from the preceding step; its whiskering completes the comparison with the assigned ordinary derivedPush. The sectionDerived functors depend on each realization only through proposition-valued structure, so these are the fixed Family section presentations by proof irrelevance.

Unpack boundedConstructible K as a native bounded constructible L and an isomorphism sectionDerived(L) to K. C.preserves gives constructibility of actual(L), hence of native derivedPush(L) by the identity-extension isomorphism and isomorphism closure of the native predicate. Realize this native derived image by sectionDerived. The properTransport component followed by ordinary derivedPush applied to the given input isomorphism is an isomorphism from that realization to ordinary derivedPush(K). This is exactly the witness required by boundedConstructible on T. No essential-image surjectivity, new realization choice, tensor comparison or adjunction-comparison equation is required; empty schemes and the zero object are handled by the same constructions.

lean.statement:
theorem adic_proper_ordinary_push_preservation (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p) (F : Family l D)
    (Z T : GeometricSpace D) (p : Z.base ⟶ T.base)
    (hp : IsProper p.left)
    (O : Operations l p.left (F.data Z).realization (F.data T).realization) :
    ∀ K, boundedConstructible l Z.base.left (F.data Z).realization K →
      boundedConstructible l T.base.left (F.data T).realization
        ((ContinuousRational.DirectImage.derivedPush p.left O.coefficient).obj K)
